required_panel_emphasis: The seed is the backing. The previously working arrangement achieves writable sprout storage through btrfs device add. Trace that actual path; do not assume each exposed Incus subvolume must itself be the block-device operand.
precedence: Latest owner correction supersedes narrower no-per-container-loop interpretations in historical conversations and draft briefs.
required_design_constraint: No host loop devices. Do not silently exempt pool-level backing, seed wrappers, per-container images or device mappings described as stored in Cozo.
observed_conflict: Historical Oct19 receipts show /dev/loop0 backing existing Incus pool 3tched at /var/lib/incus/disks/3tched.img. This is evidence of current-versus-required drift, not permission to preserve it as an architectural exemption.
mutation_scope: Evidence and diagnostic handoff only. No detach, pool migration, deletion, seed modification or other storage operation authorized by this correction.
jev_requirement: Judge each proposal against no-host-loops and the complete retained provisioning, immutable-seed, identity and upgrade requirements. A database association alone is not proof that a host kernel loop mapping has been eliminated. Return exact evidence or uncertainty; do not invent impossibility proofs.
